name: qaren
description: QaReN: a QA companion for React Native harnesses — walks a plan on the simulator or emulator, records the run, and reports PASS/FAIL with video.

interface.shortDescription: QA a React Native app on a device with evidence
interface.longDescription: Run the qaren CLI from Codex to QA a pull request or the working tree on an iOS simulator or Android emulator and read the receipt back.
defaultPrompt: QA this pull request on the iOS simulator.
Check the working tree with QaReN.
